decision.bounded_repair: Build the unmodified upstream Linux v6.18 CS4270 codec as one out-of-tree module against the exact distribution headers.
decision.oled: Use the distribution spidev module and a bounded user-space service; do not carry the historical fbtft SSD1322 driver.

nonclaim: Package inspection proves driver configuration only. It does not prove that the module loads or the physical codec works on the Pi fixture.
